english.title: Possess nuclear material the import / export of which is prohibited / restricted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly acquired possession of nuclear material with intent to evade a

(A)_[prohibition]_
(B)_[restriction, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RESTRICTION..),]_

in force by virtue of an enactment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..), relating to the importation, exportation or shipment as stores of nuclear material
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(1)(a)(iii), (3) and (4C) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Any goods in respect of which an offence under this section is committed shall be liable to forfeiture.

Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a penalty of three times the value of the goods or a fine not exceeding £20,000 whichever is the greater.
